question_text: An otherwise healthy 27-year-old man presents to the Emergency Department with dark urine and left flank pain. He has had a fever, sore throat, and malaise for the last 2 days. Physical examination reveals enlarged tonsils with tender anterior cervical lymphadenopathy. Urinalysis shows pink urine with 20–25 red cells/high power field and 2+ protein. This patient’s condition is most likely due to which of the following?
